SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), SUM(net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) sl, SUM(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22')
SELECT store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT format) f, COUNT(*) v FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT format)>1 OR COUNT(*)>1

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, cs.format, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
),
ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) qr, COUNT(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT format, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) excl_lines,
 SUM(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test') sold_net,
 SUM(COALESCE(refund_net,0)) FILTER (WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test') refund,
 ROUND(100*SUM(COALESCE(refund_net,0)) FILTER (WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test')/SUM(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test'),2) rate,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ret.qr>sold.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_ret,
 SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity+0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date > f.sale_date+30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late, MAX(r.return_date), MIN(r.refund_net), MAX(r.return_date - f.sale_date) maxlag,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.product_key<>f.product_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prodmismatch
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, o.status, f.sale_date,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) disp
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT status, COUNT(*), SUM(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') by_order,
 SUM(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE disp BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') by_disp FROM w GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line
    GROUP BY sales_line_id
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cs.format, f.net_amount, COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0) AS refund_net
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, format,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(refund_net) / SUM(net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY format
